reasons: The server host mcp.paypal.com is a subdomain of PayPal's main domain, paypal.com, and it matches the official remote MCP server in PayPal's documentation.
The sign-in host is the same as the server host, so sign-ins go to PayPal and not a third party.
The documented endpoints are http and sse, not mcp, but the host is PayPal's, so the path difference is minor.
